record.context_brief: Asymptotic constant for interval symmetry numbers
record.original_question: In the asymptotic formula lim_{r→∞} r^2 · ms_r(I) = inf_{r∈N} r^2 · ms_r(I) = S', determine or estimate the constant S'. Is S' strictly larger than the constant S defined from the autoconvolution infimum appearing in the lower bound for ms_r(I)?

evidence.quote: The exact value of the constant S is not known.
(6) limr→∞ r2 · msr(I) = infr∈N r2 · msr(I) = S′ for some constant S′ such that S ≤ S′ < 5/6;
Problem 6.5. Calculate or evaluate the constant S′ from Theorem 6.2(6). Is S′ > S?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $I=[0,1]$ denote the unit interval equipped with Lebesgue measure $\lambda$. A measurable set $A\subseteq I$ is called symmetric if there exists $c\in\mathbb{R}$ such that $A=2c-A$. For a measurable $r$-coloring $\chi:I\to\{1,\dots,r\}$ define
$$ms(\chi)=\sup\{\lambda(A): A\subseteq I\text{ is measurable, symmetric, and monochromatic for }\chi\},$$
and set
$$ms_r(I)=\inf_{\chi}ms(\chi),$$
where the infimum runs over all measurable $r$-colorings of $I$.

It is known that the limit
$$S' \;:=\; \lim_{r\to\infty} r^2\cdot ms_r(I) \;=\; \inf_{r\in\mathbb{N}} r^2\cdot ms_r(I)$$
exists and is finite, and that $S\le S' < 5/6$, where $S$ is the autoconvolution constant
$$S \;=\; \inf_{f}\,\|f*f\|_\infty,$$
the infimum being taken over all nonnegative measurable functions $f:\mathbb{R}\to[0,\infty)$ with $\operatorname{supp}(f)\subseteq[0,1]$ and $\int_{\mathbb{R}} f(x)\,dx = 1$, with $(f*f)(x)=\int f(t)f(x-t)\,dt$.

Determine, or give nontrivial estimates for, the constant $S'$. In particular, decide whether the strict inequality $S' > S$ holds.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in a survey of open problems on symmetry and colorings (Banakh, 2011) where it is explicitly posed as Problem 6.5, and the survey notes that even the value of the related autoconvolution constant $S$ is unknown. No subsequent literature found resolves the value of $S'$ or settles whether $S'>S$, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Symmetry and colorings: some results and open problems, II
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of results and open problems on colorings of geometric and algebraic objects endowed with symmetries.
status_evidence.claim: The problem of evaluating S' and deciding S'>S is posed as an open problem in this survey.

status_evidence.title: A Ramsey Treatment of Symmetry (Banakh, Verbitsky, Vorobets)
status_evidence.snippet: Defines ms(Ω,r) and studies asymptotics of ms([0,1],r); related autoconvolution lower bounds.
status_evidence.claim: Background source defining ms_r(I) and the autoconvolution constant S used in the problem.
